task.title: Context-Aware Task Execution with Smart Subagent Spawning
task.problem: Large plans exhaust context before completion, requiring manual /clear calls between implementation waves. Task 029 (13 tasks, 630 lines) required several waves due to context exhaustion. Even with Claude Code's auto-compaction, task-specific details (line numbers, code snippets in action blocks) get lost during summarization.
task.value: - Seamless execution of large plans without user intervention - Each complex task gets fresh subagent context with exactly what it needs - Main conversation stays lean for orchestration (~15% context) - No reliance on auto-compaction as a feature - Foundation for future parallel task execution
task.acceptance-criteria: Given any plan with tasks When running festina-implement Then complex tasks (3+ files, pattern ref, code snippets) execute in fresh subagent And simple tasks can execute inline in the orchestrator And orchestrator stays under 30% context usage throughout And no manual /clear required between tasks And plan.xml task completion is persisted after each task
